items.title: Constitutional and Ponytail alignment
items.summary: Verify the formation concept against Constitutional Architectonics, current Architectonic contracts, and the Ponytail reuse/delete ladder.
acceptance: Alignment names source limits and does not invent unavailable paper definitions
Teleology precedes ontology, evidence classification, authority, and consequence
MVP deletes custom scanning, ontology, credential, deployment, graph, and hosted-relay systems

items.title: Spec Kit feature contract and clean Rail
items.summary: Create a branch-local Spec Kit constitution, feature specification, plan, tasks, and one canonical Rail initialized empty before ticket population.
acceptance: Feature has independently testable user stories
Plan passes the branch constitution check
Rail is the only live ticket status authority

items.title: Implement plan-only Origin start command
items.summary: Add a thin CLI dispatcher and a bounded formation module that reuses status JSON, parses explicit goals, selects an inference candidate, and emits a zero-mutation plan.
acceptance: Existing commands delegate to packages/workframe/bin/workframe.js unchanged
Output contains authorization_required=true, inspected_paths=[], and mutations=[]
No provider call, path inspection, filesystem mutation, or new dependency

items.title: Verify and document the minimal slice
items.summary: Add one standard-library test, update package documentation, and run the final Ponytail diff review.
acceptance: Goal parsing, candidate priority, zero-mutation output, and command execution are checked
Package README states start is experimental and plan-only
Final diff has no avoidable dependency, abstraction, or speculative feature

items.title: Cross-platform package verification
items.summary: Run the packed CLI on supported host environments and prove the new dispatcher preserves the existing status command.
acceptance: Packed npm artifact runs on Windows
At least one macOS or Linux run is recorded
Interactive start is checked in a real TTY
